notes.title: Coffeehouse - Delicious Devlog#1 | Coffee machine and cafes around city
notes.content:
Hello coffee makers!

Welcome to the first ever devlog about [i]Coffeehouse Simulator[/i] game !!!

In this devlog, we'll be discussing the process of creating a 3D graphic for our first ever coffee machine and building the environment for our coffee shop!

[h1]Coffee in da HOUSE[/h1]

Creating the environment for our coffee shop was a fun job. 
We wanted players to feel immersed in a cozy and vibrant coffeehouse setting, complete with tables, chairs, counters, and other elements typically found in a bustling café. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465024/e24c390f4375d993a2333c753111abb098c6eb96.gif[/img]

To better understand how the typical "coffeehouse" feels, our graphics and level artists visited some places in city :D
The sight of such bars, cafes, bakeries, etc. helped us understand how to make this environment so "fiery" and "chill"

Our level designer drank 6 coffees in one day !!! Such a dedication! (mostly he drinks around 5)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465024/8f2e76224dd6db197209c19e0c361ff83798878f.gif[/img]

[h3]Loooook closely into this coffee machine![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465024/d8e2411db753fa06bfa628421b19c372109a551a.gif[/img]

[h2]Now it's time to show you how we made this :D[/h2]

[h1]Creating the 3D Coffee Machine[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465024/f8f25e8c347a90ed83ca069d5af0ed55fc59fe06.png[/img]

First you need some schematics, see how measurements show it have etc.
Coffeehouse is a realistic game - most parts need to be in realistic scale.
To make our coffeehouse experience authentic, we started by researching different coffeemaker models and collecting reference pictures to help our design process.
We even have a coffee machine in our office :D
Everyone can use it (but no one wants to clean it ;/)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465024/ec30d6eb5bfb5f26fe488d9bb07d60a75adba910.jpg[/img]
[i]Schematics are important[/i]

Here you can see some assembly progress in accelerated form :D
I could put the whole thing in a GIF :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465024/a60ac3112051a4be55f4b03749b3752e4db42544.gif[/img]

We paid close attention to every intricate detail, from the buttons and knobs to the steam wand and portafilter. We are using a Blender 3d software.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465024/89c4332bb5daf2533263453ecf4e8b4af47ebe63.gif[/img]

And now In color :D
"Goldenish-brown" - thats how i call it :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465024/38143a8ffe8f26d8ff51643e6d8c45f293755bf3.gif[/img]

After several iterations and refinements, we completed the 3D model of the coffee machine.
After modeling, the graphic designers made sure to optimize the mesh and texture resolution to ensure smooth performance in the game engine. 
This is an important part of game development!!! You need to get rid of "technical debt" as soon as possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465024/74afbc05f898e239b592f296b70e384d3ca03991.png[/img]

----

That's all for today but never fear coffee is here :D More info [i]soon[/i] as always ;)


Best regards,
Baked Games Team

notes.title: Try out demo of our new game - Plow the Snow !
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hello dear Players![/h1][/b]

We got special announcement for you!
We wanna invite you - [b]Players [/b]to check out a demo for a new game that we are developing!
This game is called [i]Plow the Snow![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c1d67ad0b06f2c99e712213c149b3100db3b3f16.png[/img]

What is it game about? It is a [b]simulator[/b] and [b]casual relaxing[/b] game with a bit cartoony stylized graphic centered around getting rid of the snow in various places !
Help your clients and neighbors get through this winter season. 
You can use multiple machines and brave any obstacle in your path to make the sidewalks and streets free from the snowflake menace!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0231325a478a41b61da6d57cded1bef56bbd869f.gif[/img]

[h3]What can you expect in demo version? 
[/h3]

[h3]-Two different levels + garage !

-Great stylized graphic and atmosphere

-Relaxing gameplay and music.

-Fixing stuff in your vehicle in garage! 

-A lot of fun (and a lot of snow to plow) ![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7c07d517acd343d39317b60bf8e6152be0b7a9c1.gif[/img]

Full version will have a lot of levels and also a multiplayer!

Put your gloves on, warm jackets and be ready to Plow the Snow!
Don’t wait, help Snow Angeles to clean up the snow in city !
[h2]Download demo on Steam and don’t forget to wishlist the full game 😉[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1967530/Plow_the_Snow/

Players feedback was always close in our hearts and we want to fulfill every player's desire !
Tell us in comments, on Steam Community or on our Discord server what was your's feelings about game ;)

Enjoy and have fun!

Baked Games Team
